theorem: For an oriented square boundary map Q, det(Q*Q)=abs(det Q)^2; in the real case det Q is a signed analytic square root.
self_adjoint_lift: The chiral block operator [[0,Q*],[Q,0]] is self-adjoint and detects failure of invertibility of Q by zero modes.
construction_order: Q must be derived from source boundary data before forming Q*Q; taking a square root or Cholesky factor of a completed Gram operator is circular.
hostile_falsifier: The scalar generic transfer defect 1-x^2 has no polynomial first-order factor over R[x].
open_target: Derive a relative boundary map Q_P with I-C_P*C_P=Q_P*Q_P compatibly at every cutoff.
status: minimal surviving architecture; source map unavailable; no RH proof
